answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting or grading, every identity must lock 300 OPAL in escrow, sign the registration with a quill (a USB hardware signing token), and broadcast one pulse (a single on-chain event). A farm of 1,000 clones locks 300,000 OPAL and loses the full deposit when an audit slashes the clone-pattern stake. Honesty stays cheaper.
